generic_name: Arginine Pyroglutamate, Coleus Forskohlii, Glutamine, Glycine, Mucuna Pruriens, Ornithine Alpha-Ketoglutarate, Dioscorea Villosa, Tyrosine (combination supplement)
drug_class: Dietary Supplement / Natural Growth Hormone Secretagogue Blend
purpose: This combination supplement is used to naturally support the body's own production of growth hormone, which may help with muscle building, fat metabolism, energy levels, and recovery after exercise. It is also used by some people to support overall vitality, hormonal balance, and healthy aging. It is not a prescription hormone and works by encouraging your body to release more of its own natural hormones.
how_it_works: Each ingredient in this blend plays a specific supporting role — for example, arginine and ornithine are amino acids that signal your pituitary gland in the brain to release more growth hormone naturally. Coleus forskohlii and Dioscorea villosa help support hormonal balance and metabolism, while mucuna pruriens provides L-DOPA, a building block for dopamine that also supports growth hormone release. Glutamine, glycine, and tyrosine are amino acids that provide building blocks for proteins, neurotransmitters, and muscle recovery.
common_side_effects: Most people tolerate this supplement well, but some may experience mild stomach upset, nausea, or diarrhea especially when starting out. You might also notice mild headaches, restlessness, or changes in energy or sleep patterns. Mucuna pruriens can occasionally cause nausea or vivid dreams due to its effects on dopamine levels.
warnings: Do not use this supplement if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or under 18 years of age without talking to your doctor first. People with hormone-sensitive conditions such as certain cancers, diabetes, thyroid disorders, or those taking medications for blood pressure, diabetes, or mental health conditions should consult their doctor before use. This supplement can affect hormone levels and may interact with medications, so always let your healthcare provider know you are taking it.
typical_dosing: Dosing varies by brand, but typically adults take this supplement once daily, often at bedtime on an empty stomach, since growth hormone is naturally released during sleep. Always follow the specific directions on the product label you are using, and start with the lowest recommended dose to see how your body responds.
